papers.title: On the static dielectric constant of thin dielectrics in extremely scaled silicon nanosheet transistors
papers.summary: We argue that the static dielectric constant of small (thin and/or narrow) semiconductor and insulator nanostructures depends strongly on the their environment. We do so by considering the electronic response simply reviewing, briefly but critically, the existing literature. Regarding the ionic response, in addition to reviewing the literature, we use a simple model to account for the confinement of optical phonons in thin films and show that the reduction of their density of states has a negligible effect on the dielectric constant, in contrast to some claims found in the literature. In general, we argue that in realistic structures, such as double-gated Si nanosheets, the use of the bulk dielectric constants for both the channel and the gate insulators, is justified.
papers.abstract_cn: 我们认为，小尺寸（薄和/或窄）半导体及绝缘体纳米结构的静态介电常数强烈依赖于其所处环境。为此，我们考察了电子响应，并对现有文献进行了简要但批判性的综述。对于离子响应，除综述文献外，我们还采用一个简单模型来描述薄膜中光学声子的限域，并表明其态密度的降低对介电常数的影响可以忽略不计，这与文献中的某些观点相反。总体而言，我们认为，在双栅 Si 纳米片等实际结构中，对沟道和栅极绝缘层均采用体材料介电常数是合理的。

papers.title: Thermal Processing Limits in Oxide-Channel Ferroelectric Field Effect Transistors
papers.summary: In this work, we report a systematic study of the impact of high-temperature post-capping thermal annealing on the memory characteristics of Oxide-semiconductor channel ferroelectric field-effect transistors (OS-FeFETs). Using an identical engineered ferroelectric gate stack—8 nm Hf ${}_{{0}.{5}}$ Zr ${}_{{0}.{5}}$ O 2 (HZO) / 3 nm Al 2 O 3 / 8 nm HZO (8/3/8)—and a hybrid capping layer (3 nm HfO ${}_{{2}} +3$ nm Al 2 O 3 ), 10% Ga-doped In 2 O 3 (IGO)–channel and 4% W-doped In 2 O 3 (IWO)–channel FeFETs remain functional after annealing at temperatures up to $650~^{\circ } $ C for durations of up to 30 min and 10 min, respectively; further annealing results in irreversible loss of conduction and device failure. Detailed electrical analysis reveals that the MW enhancement originates from a preferential positive shift in the erased-state threshold voltage, while the programmed-state threshold voltage remains comparatively stable. Grazing-incidence X-ray diffraction measurements further indicate structural evolution in the IWO and IGO oxide channels with increasing annealing temperature, supporting the observed electrical trends.
papers.abstract_cn: 本工作系统研究了高温封帽后热退火对氧化物半导体沟道铁电场效应晶体管（OS-FeFET）存储特性的影响。采用相同的工程化铁电栅叠层——8 nm Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂（HZO）/ 3 nm Al₂O₃ / 8 nm HZO（8/3/8）——以及混合封帽层（3 nm HfO₂ + 3 nm Al₂O₃），10% Ga 掺杂 In₂O₃（IGO）沟道和 4% W 掺杂 In₂O₃（IWO）沟道 FeFET 分别在最高 650 °C 下退火 30 min 和 10 min 后仍可正常工作；进一步退火则会导致不可逆的导电性丧失和器件失效。详细电学分析表明，存储窗口（MW）的增大源于擦除态阈值电压优先发生正向漂移，而编程态阈值电压则保持相对稳定。掠入射 X 射线衍射测量进一步表明，随着退火温度升高，IWO 和 IGO 氧化物沟道发生结构演化，从而支持了所观察到的电学变化趋势。

papers.title: Depth-Resolved Lattice Distortions in a Silicon-Germanium Qubit Host
papers.summary: Semiconductor qubits, promising for quantum computation, inherit properties from their host lattice. Quantum dot spins, occupying the local lowest energy states in the conduction band, necessarily couple to structural disorder and interfaces. While silicon-based systems promise low noise alongside industrially compatible manufacturing, the growth of SiGe---a leading platform---unavoidably introduces lattice dislocations, inhomogeneous strain, and crosshatch patterns, expected to cause fluctuations between devices, qubit failure, and subsequently higher operational overhead. Through X-ray nano-structural mapping of an Intel Si/SiGe chip, we reveal, with 30$~$nm lateral and 200$~$nm functional depth resolution, how extended lattice defects introduced during growth propagate through the heterostructure, creating permanently distorted lattice planes and strain. We correlate these at the $\approx1~μ$m scale of a quantum dot device and calculate the impact on qubit energy spectra. We observe crosshatch fine structure and find that substrate miscut and growth correlate with the final crosshatch pattern.
papers.abstract_cn: 作为量子计算的有前景载体，半导体量子比特继承了其宿主晶格的性质。占据导带局域最低能量态的量子点自旋必然会与结构无序和界面发生耦合。尽管基于硅的系统兼具低噪声前景和工业兼容的制造能力，但作为领先平台的 SiGe 生长不可避免地会引入晶格位错、非均匀应变和交叉网纹图案，预计将导致器件间波动、量子比特失效，并进而增加运行开销。通过对 Intel Si/SiGe 芯片进行 X 射线纳米结构映射，我们以 30 nm 横向分辨率和 200 nm 有效深度分辨率揭示了生长过程中引入的延展性晶格缺陷如何穿过异质结构传播，形成永久畸变的晶格平面和应变。我们将这些结果与量子点器件约 1 μm 尺度的特征进行关联，并计算其对量子比特能谱的影响。我们观测到交叉网纹细结构，并发现衬底偏切和生长过程与最终的交叉网纹图案相关。

papers.title: Active Passivation Tunes Hotspot Locations in GaN Transistors with In Situ Thermal Mechanical Visualization
papers.summary: Efficient thermal dissipation has become critical in emerging electronic devices. However, most existing studies have primarily focused on engineering heat dissipation pathways, largely overlooking the intrinsic behavior of the heat source itself. We demonstrate an active passivation technology that proactively tunes hotspot locations in GaN transistors. By adjusting the active passivation layer length, the hotspot is shifted from the gate edge to the drain-side AP edge, establishing a clear one-to-one spatial correlation. In-situ thermal-mechanical visualization via micro-Raman thermography, combined with multi-physics electro-thermal-mechanical simulations, directly captures the spatial redistribution of both temperature and thermal stress profiles. Electrical analysis confirms that this hotspot migration is driven by the spatial shift of the peak electric field and localized Joule heating. This proactive heat-source tuning strategy provides critical design guidelines for power electronics.
papers.abstract_cn: 高效散热已成为新兴电子器件中的关键问题。然而，现有大多数研究主要聚焦于热耗散路径的工程设计，而在很大程度上忽略了热源本身的内在行为。我们展示了一种可主动调控 GaN 晶体管热点位置的有源钝化技术。通过调节有源钝化层长度，热点可从栅极边缘转移至漏极侧有源钝化层边缘，并建立清晰的一一空间对应关系。借助显微拉曼测温进行原位热-机械可视化，并结合多物理场电-热-机械仿真，可直接捕获温度和热应力分布的空间重分布。电学分析证实，该热点迁移由峰值电场和局域焦耳热的空间转移驱动。这种主动热源调控策略为功率电子器件提供了关键设计指导。

papers.title: Rectangular Four-Level Stacked SiGe Nanosheet GAA Transistors Based on Si/SiGe Stacks Enabled by a Novel SGI-TMAH Channel Release Process
papers.summary: To overcome SiGe channel loss and morphology degradation during channel release, a novel SiGe inhibitor-added TMAH (SGI-TMAH) solution is developed for SiGe nanosheet GAA transistors. Compared with the previously reported S-TMAH solution, SGI-TMAH improves the Si to SiGe selectivity from 23.5:1 to 80.6:1, enabling four-level stacked rectangular SiGe nanosheets from conventional Si/SiGe stacks. As a result, the footprint-normalized I ON increases by 41.1% while maintaining an I ON /I OFF ratio above $10^{{6}}$ . Although some degradation in SS, DIBL, and I OFF is observed due to weakened electrostatic control, further nanosheet scaling toward ~5 nm should improve electrostatic characteristics. This work validates a feasible channel release scheme applicable to SiGe channel GAA technologies.
papers.abstract_cn: 为克服沟道释放过程中 SiGe 沟道损失和形貌退化的问题，针对 SiGe 纳米片 GAA 晶体管开发了一种新型添加 SiGe 抑制剂的 TMAH（SGI-TMAH）溶液。与此前报道的 S-TMAH 溶液相比，SGI-TMAH 将 Si 对 SiGe 的选择比从 23.5:1 提升至 80.6:1，从而能够基于传统 Si/SiGe 堆叠形成四层堆叠的矩形 SiGe 纳米片。因此，在保持 ION/IOFF 比值高于 10⁶ 的同时，按占地面积归一化的 ION 提升了 41.1%。尽管由于静电控制减弱，亚阈值摆幅（SS）、漏致势垒降低（DIBL）和 IOFF 出现一定退化，但将纳米片进一步缩放至约 5 nm 有望改善静电特性。本工作验证了一种适用于 SiGe 沟道 GAA 技术的可行沟道释放方案。

papers.title: 600 V/1 A Enhancement-Mode β -Ga 2 O 3 MOSFETs With Graded Doping Engineering
papers.summary: In this letter, we have demonstrated high performance enhancement-mode (E-mode) $\beta $ -Ga 2 O 3 recessed-gate metal-oxide-semiconductor field-effect- transistors (RG-MOSFETs) with ampere-level drain current ( ${I}_{\text {D}}\text {)}$ and > 600 V breakdown voltage (BV) via graded channel doping engineering. With the n + - and n-Ga 2 O 3 layers beneath the gate etched and the unintentional doped- (UID-)Ga 2 O 3 preserved, the threshold voltage ( ${V}_{\text {TH}}\text {)}$ with high uniformity of 9 V, a recorded top-gate E-mode ${I}_{\text {D}}$ of 130 mA/mm and low specific on-resistance ( ${R}_{\text {on, {sp}}}\text {)}$ of 19 m $\Omega \cdot $ cm 2 are all achieved for small periphery FETs. Combined with source and gate field plates (FP), the small periphery RG-MOSFET with gate-to-drain spacing ( ${L}_{\text {GD}}\text {)}$ of $10~\mu $ m demonstrates a high BV of $2.46~{k}$ V, yielding a state-of-the-art power figure of merit (P-FOM) of 318 MW/cm 2 . By scaling the gate width ( ${W}_{\text {ch}}\text {)}$ to 20 mm, Ampere-level ${I}_{\text {D}}$ with BV > 600 V was also achieved with ${V}_{\text {TH}}$ maintained to be ~9 V, showing a high process variation immunity. Given the significant potential of $\beta $ -Ga 2 O 3 MOSFETs in power devices, such E-mode high-current and high-voltage results verify their great promises for next-generation electronics.
papers.abstract_cn: 在本快报中，我们通过梯度沟道掺杂工程，展示了具有安培级漏极电流（ID）和超过 600 V 击穿电压（BV）的高性能增强型（E-mode）β-Ga₂O₃ 凹栅金属氧化物半导体场效应晶体管（RG-MOSFET）。通过刻蚀栅极下方的 n⁺-Ga₂O₃ 和 n-Ga₂O₃ 层，并保留非故意掺杂（UID）Ga₂O₃ 层，小周长 FET 同时实现了均匀性良好的 9 V 阈值电压（VTH）、创纪录的 130 mA/mm 顶栅增强型 ID，以及 19 mΩ·cm² 的低比导通电阻（Ron,sp）。结合源极和栅极场板（FP），栅漏间距（LGD）为 10 μm 的小周长 RG-MOSFET 实现了 2.46 kV 的高 BV，并获得 318 MW/cm² 的先进功率优值（P-FOM）。当栅宽（Wch）扩展至 20 mm 时，在 VTH 维持约 9 V 的条件下，同样实现了 BV > 600 V 的安培级 ID，显示出较强的工艺波动耐受性。鉴于 β-Ga₂O₃ MOSFET 在功率器件中的巨大潜力，这些增强型高电流、高电压结果验证了其在下一代电子技术中的广阔前景。

papers.title: The Ballistic Injection in IGZO GAA VFET With Scaled Source/Drain Extension and Its Impact on On-Current Enhancement
papers.summary: In this work, the impact of source/drain (S/D) extension scaling on the performance of indium-gallium-zinc oxide (IGZO) gate-all-around (GAA) vertical field-effect transistors (VFETs) is systematically studied both theoretically and experimentally. The electron transport at the S/D extension is investigated by drift-diffusion (DD) simulation and ballistic injection simulation. It is observed that the I-V characteristics at high V DS of IGZO GAA VFET with scaled S/D extension deviate significantly from the velocity saturation model due to the electron velocity overshoot at the S/D extension region. A ballistic injection model is introduced that can well explain the experimental I-V characteristics. It is found that the S extension scaling, rather than the D extension scaling, is more effective for on-current (I ${}_{\text {on}}\text {)}$ enhancement. By S extension scaling (down to 5 nm), the I on enhancement is demonstrated experimentally, showing a high I on of $569~\mu $ A/ $\mu $ m (V ${}_{\text {D}} =2.2$ V).
papers.abstract_cn: 本工作从理论和实验两方面系统研究了源/漏（S/D）延伸区缩放对铟镓锌氧化物（IGZO）全环栅（GAA）垂直场效应晶体管（VFET）性能的影响。采用漂移-扩散（DD）仿真和弹道注入仿真研究了 S/D 延伸区中的电子输运。结果表明，具有缩放 S/D 延伸区的 IGZO GAA VFET 在高 VDS 下的 I-V 特性，由于 S/D 延伸区中的电子速度过冲而显著偏离速度饱和模型。所引入的弹道注入模型能够很好地解释实验 I-V 特性。研究发现，相较于漏极延伸区缩放，源极延伸区缩放对导通电流（Ion）增强更有效。通过将源极延伸区缩放至 5 nm，实验展示了 Ion 增强，在 VD = 2.2 V 时实现了高达 569 μA/μm 的 Ion。
